title: Golden Route Lowrider Tour
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Not available for children who need car seats
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Join the Golden Route Photoshoot Tour in a classic convertible ’64 Impala Lowrider, with a knowledgeable guide who doubles as your photographer. The three-hour tour comfortably seats up to four passengers, starting with pick-up at Beverly Hills Park by the famous Beverly Hills sign. 

You'll cruise through the palm-lined streets and luxurious homes of Beverly Hills, then head toward the coast to explore the Santa Monica Pier, the artsy Abbott Kinney, and the charming Venice Canals. As you cruise through some of LA’s most iconic spots, your guide will help capture your experience. They’ll happily take photos on your camera or phone at no extra charge, so you can keep memories from the journey. The tour finishes with a stop at the Santa Monica Pier for stunning ocean views.

We offer custom and private tours tailored just for you! Reach out to discuss your vision, and we’ll craft you an unforgettable tour of Los Angeles.
